summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. (foreign private issuer, Form 6-K) reported entry into a Purchase and Investment Agreement on April 22, 2026 to acquire a majority equity stake in S phia High Tech S.r.l., an Italian aerospace/defense firm. Under the agreement, Genenta initially acquires 19.9% for €3.25M in cash via capital increase and payments to founders, with an option to acquire up to 51% total through a second tranche (subject to EBITDA milestones, ~€2.25M) and earnout up to €0.5M. The company has a unilateral second-tranche option. Closing requires Italian Golden Power government approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and milestone achievement risk.
